Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in League City, Texas, and was turning left when the vehicle was
struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the same roadway. Driver 1 is the named insured on the
policy involved. Upon arrival, the responding officer confirmed Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel, and a
Passenger was also present in the vehicle, as both occupants were identified at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in
the left knee, which the officer noted is consistent with the direction and force of the impact to the driver side of the
vehicle. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it. Two witnesses on the sidewalk gave
statements that matched this account, and photographs taken at the scene show damage concentrated on the front
driver side and the corresponding area of the other vehicle. The damage appears largely in line with the reoprted
impact. No piror damage to the vehicle was known to any party or observed by the officer. Traffic control was not
active at the time, and no citations were issued at the scene.
